name: remote-mobile-acceptance
goal: The native acceptance of the iOS app is repeatable from the repository: one supported script builds the simulator products from the working tree, starts its own fixture computer and its own simulator, drives the real web view through pairing, Keychain, relaunch, media, saved copies, reconnect, revocation and the Release refusal with named assertions, and writes screenshots and a source-bound report to ignored output.

title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
Add or update focused automated coverage.
Run the relevant project verification commands.

evidence: One supported script, own fixture computer and own simulator, named assertions, source-bound report in ignored output, no account, no code or key printed, system prompts out of scope. Root accepted the scope and the 57/0 run.

packages/desktop/scripts/ios-acceptance.ts with its phase, source, simulator, page, record and guard modules; build-ios-simulator.ts and ios-products.ts verify every product. README section 'iOS app on a simulator'. Audit passes after moving the page prelude to its own module.

Run 5: 57 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 (/tmp/harness-ios-acceptance-5.log, work/mobile/ios-acceptance/report.json), source held still, seven screenshots inspected. Unit: ios-acceptance-guards 4, ios-build-options 3, ios-simulator-entitlements 5 passed. Not repeated after the audit shape fix.
